image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile's head resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the texture of the skin, the eye, and the interlocking teeth of the slightly open jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nose, forming a V-shape characteristic of crocodiles rather than the U-shape of alligators. The head structure appears anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible. Crucially, the fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears to fit into a notch in the upper jaw (interlocking), which is a key diagnostic feature for crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal). A vertical slit pupil is visible. The surrounding tissue suggests the presence of protective membranes consistent with reptilian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril openings are clearly visible at the distal end of the snout, appearing as distinct slits.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck region are visible; the full body length cannot be verified from this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the top of the head and neck shows distinct, raised, bony plates (scutes) with a rough, armored appearance typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green, brown, and grey. The texture is highly detailed, showing cracks and ridges consistent with real reptile skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (belly) of the crocodile is not visible in this angle; only the lateral and dorsal aspects of the jaw/neck are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the field of view.
